name: TinyClaw Proof of Life
description: Phase 5: Verify TinyClaw can make a real tool call via agentic dispatch. The adapter calls the Anthropic Messages API directly with gateway tools, bypassing PicoClaw's text-only dispatch.
process: Call github_fetch to read gateway/main.go from tinyland-inc/remote-juggler and note response characteristics
Call github_fetch to read cmd/rj-gateway/main.go for comparative analysis of tool call patterns
Report function definitions from both files, comparing file sizes and processing efficiency
Test error handling by attempting to fetch a non-existent file and document graceful failure behavior
Calculate tool call efficiency metrics (response time patterns, data throughput)
Store performance metrics in setec key 'campaigns/tc-proof-of-life/history' for trend analysis
Write a __memory__ reflection about performance patterns and optimization opportunities for future campaigns

metrics.successCriteria: Agent called github_fetch multiple times (>=2), performed comparative file analysis, calculated efficiency metrics, correctly identified function types, demonstrated error handling, and provided performance benchmarks.
